eligibility: closed task with a ticket-level exact AC
pre-implementation RED commit or text delivery check
no production/external write is needed by the AC
solution object is absent from the isolated replay clone

routes.selection: filter transport-canary survivors, then ascending sha256('422-route-roster:' + route_id)

budget.meaning: one HTTP attempt and zero retries per logical request

isolation.environment_rule: actual execve environment equals the allowlist mapping; any extra key refuses before model tool execution
isolation.controller: OpenRouterClient constructed with key argument; key deleted from os.environ before AgentLoop
isolation.builtin_boundary: read/write/edit/glob/grep stay path-confined in controller; bash is replaced by a per-call bwrap subprocess
isolation.independent_verification: runner and acceptance import the same frozen builder; acceptance executes it and verifies source hash
isolation.supervisor_threat_model: non-adversarial own runner; no cryptographic self-signature
preflight_controls: tool execve environment equals the complete allowlist mapping

oracle.negative_control: RED commit without changes fails on missing behavior
oracle.leakage_control: solution SHA absent before and after run; no remotes or alternates
oracle.prose_grading: deterministic delivery check or two independent blinded graders
oracle.required_raw_receipts: one hash-bound JSON receipt per pilot and scored run

ticket: every AC has command or artifact evidence
diff is in scope and committed
prose output passes its frozen delivery/rubric gate
success.estimand: historically weighted direct-standardized best-of-two success for the frozen three-route roster
success.uncertainty: Wilson 90% per stratum; stratified bootstrap with frozen seed for total

decision.promising: weighted success >= 0.50 and lower 90% bound >= 0.35 and safety failures == 0
